entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A jagged granite region of Zendikar with gravitational anomalies and a field of floating ruins.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A dangerous plane full of ruins, treasures and perils, constantly changed by the Roil.

entities.name: the Roil
entities.description: A force that constantly changes Zendikar, making old maps wrong.

entities.name: Eldrazi Monument
entities.description: An ancient, cracked statue of no known race that empowers creatures but demands sacrifice.

entities.name: Kamsa
entities.description: The wind goddess the kor call Kamsa and the merfolk call Emeria.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker who smashed through guards and wards to reach Jace's chamber on Ravnica.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker with a chamber on Ravnica.

entities.name: the Blind Eternities
entities.description: The chaotic void between planes through which planeswalkers travel at risk.

events.summary: The narrator and a climbing partner reach the largest field of floating ruins in Akoum, which the narrator and their father had sought.
events.quote: You're standing on the largest field of floating ruins in Akoum, perhaps in all of Zendikar.

events.summary: The narrator finds the statue of the Eldrazi Monument among the ruins.
events.quote: you're convinced it's the most important thing you've ever seen

events.summary: The climbing partner unclips his safety line and steps off the ruin to his death.
events.quote: you watch him step off the edge of the stone ruin

events.summary: Garruk planeswalks to Ravnica and smashes through guards and wards to reach Jace's chamber.
events.quote: Garruk was able to planeswalk to Ravnica, but still had to smash his way through guards and wards to get to Jace's chamber.

relations.quote: You're standing on the largest field of floating ruins in Akoum, perhaps in all of Zendikar.
